value: seeds of the pioneer tree (printed Trema tomentosa) did not germinate in darkness and germinated under both simulated forest-gap light (125 umol m-2 s-1) and simulated understory light (6 umol m-2 s-1); under understory light germination started later (germination start 25 d against 15 d in gap light; mean germination time 29 d against 21.8 d), and final germination, mean time and start differed significantly among the three light conditions; only the temperature requirement was gap-only, since germination in the temperature test occurred only under the 20-30 C gap cycle (93%) and none was reported at constant 30 C or 20/25 C
method: indoor seed germination under simulated gap light, understory light and darkness (14 h light, 10 h dark), plus a separate temperature test
conditions: soil seed bank species of a Hainan Island tropical rain forest; light test 3 replicates of 10 seeds per treatment for Trema; dark below 0.13 umol m-2 s-1; R:FR not measured; the chamber temperature of the light test was not settled by the text read (the summaries differed)
